output.body:
## Summary

Add the source manual enemy rules and mapped slider primitive, continuing original491b002.

```text
local x −55…55 → quadratic fraction → integer life/reward or tenth speed
manual value → square-root inverse → twip-quantized handle
text draft → separate Number/clamp rules, defer trailing speed dot
```

Uses the native artwork cache merged in #66. Authored panel/field/checkbox/confirmation integration follows separately.

## Evidence

- Formatting, TypeScript,509 rule tests (6,181 assertions) and production build pass.
- All six affected native/mock browser cases pass across existing control/editor checks and the final two mapped-slider cases (9.2s). Resize/twin/undo behavior, valid loaded scale3 with paint at57, primary-release guard and cancellation remain verified.
- New browser cases cover imported0.515396 uniform scale, handle-only activation, life375 with retained cursor12.35 after dragging to12.37, reset, endpoint clamp, cancellation once, disabled inputs and keyboard Home/End. Both final captures were inspected.
- Manual limits, quadratic arithmetic, fractional text values, invalid/range clamps and trailing-dot drafts follow TankCreatorScreen's constructor and drag/text handlers. [Pinned Ruffle x setter](https://github.com/ruffle-rs/ruffle/blob/89a7049965f3090e706265670df309a5128233ac/core/src/avm2/globals/flash/display/display_object.rs#L303-L313) and [Twips conversion](https://github.com/ruffle-rs/ruffle/blob/89a7049965f3090e706265670df309a5128233ac/swf/src/types/twips.rs#L96-L98) support twentieth-pixel truncation and below-minimum square-root NaN handling; this is not an Adobe-runtime parity claim.
- Existing resize/rotation uses the unchanged default linear mapping and paint-only clamp. Optional coordinate conversion and disabled state are exercised in an isolated fixture; the current generic enemy inspector remains a compatibility bridge until the authored UI lands. Keyboard/cancellation remain browser adapters. No generated data/media/schema changes.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert removes optional mapping/manual helpers. Saved designs and suggestion arithmetic are unchanged.

**Blast Radius:** controls

The shared slider accepts new optional behavior; existing callers retain their defaults.

`components/creator-controls.tsx` supplies positioned native/mock buttons and transform sliders, while the editor owns parts, selection, frame stepping and history. A selection key refreshes slider initialization in the layout phase; an active handle retains its chosen value. Pointer capture supports motion outside the input, and cancellation reports rollback once. The isolated fixture exercises this boundary before production screen wiring.


`TankCreator` connects source controls to immutable designs and transient selection. Gesture refs retain the pre-control design and held nudge direction; its existing fixed-step renderer clock advances held X steps, while release callbacks finalize history once. Selection bounds come from the retained artwork's Script bounds and remain frozen during a transform. The asset service still owns cached native control/ring art, and simulation helpers own arithmetic; browser handlers own gestures, cancellation and accessible actions.

`tools/lib/swf-layout.ts` shares numeric primitive/text collection and transformed declared bounds between creator layout importers. It keeps glyph matrices separate from text bounds, follows the selected SimpleButton state, and emits no original contours or media. After extracting the existing controls importer, two imports reproduced its 69,147-byte data file exactly (SHA256 `a95a22e13a3f9fcb1df294d722cfabfa6ea7001cbfe0ca8c270346d7c93645ec`). TypeScript, formatting and all486 rule tests pass; this tool-only extraction adds no runtime browser flow. Palette integration follows separately.

The collector also resolves morph leaves through the existing `morphShapeAtRatio` parser helper, passing each retained placement ratio (default0) alongside its composed matrix. Importers can reuse the same affine multiplication for nested field registration. This exposes interpolated numerical bounds/representative solid styles; it neither exports contours nor changes runtime rendering/contact or Flash Script bounds. Child sprites retain the existing frame1 traversal. Advanced enemy-panel metadata and animation integration follow separately.

The palette importer additionally samples advanced enemy panel928 and confirmation915. Its typed `advanced` section holds the basic/advanced tabs, six fields, suggestion checkbox, three slider registrations and handles, and confirmation fields/buttons plus21 frame poses. Nested text registration composes parent matrices and multiplies alpha; authored initial strings accompany numerical text metrics. This data is ready for later native caches and authored controls, with no runtime panel integration in the import slice.

Supplied-SWF loading caches37 advanced enemy art entries under `enemy:*` and the three named slider-track keys. Static panel/track rasters omit named controls; editable fields remain separate. Confirmation poses share one retained `SwfClip` tree through opening, the parent frame12/child frame11 stops, and resumed closing.
